comparison.objective: Set tubular latches to door backsets, fit them, and insert a spindle, versus tune a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch-length adjustment, door fitting, and spindle insertion versus recessed hex-key engagement, collar tuning, counterholding, and witness-torque testing.
comparison.success_condition: Each latch matches its door and accepts the spindle versus repeated safe impacts with a retained damping setting.
comparison.reason: Shared adjustment is generic; latch fitting/insertion does not test dynamic-energy response. Body and specs are absent, so backset tolerances and damage rules are missing.
